title: SLA Duration & Billing Window Calculator
brief: As a billing owner, I want outages measured against our SLA threshold and credited on the invoice, so that customers are compensated when we miss the SLA.

steps.summary: Add billing tiers and time constants
Add the SLA credit invoice generator
Add unit tests for durations and invoices

probe.question: What does parseDurationMs("1h30m") return, in milliseconds?

understanding.question: An outage lasts 1h30m against the standard tier's 1h threshold. What does the invoice generator compute?
options: A credit for the 30 minutes beyond the threshold
No credit: the outage is treated as shorter than the threshold
An error because of the duration format
